description: Ranks symbols on a given trading day by short_ratio (short_volume / total_volume) using FINRA Reg SHO daily data summed across every consolidated-NMS reporting facility. Scans the whole published day (~12,000 symbols) and returns the highest-ratio names. Useful for spotting heavily-shorted names; raise min_total_volume to exclude thinly-traded micro-caps. Zero-rated: costs 0 credits.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD; defaults to most recent published day

min_total_volume.description: Skip symbols below this consolidated total volume (default 100000)

name: short_volume_top
